1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body with __at most one light emitting diode per face of said columnar body__, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes__.

3. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes __and disposed between each adjacent fin__.

4. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

5. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and has substantially straight side walls__.

8. (Original) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

9. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and a single diode resides on each face__.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK.

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and said lamp has a general A19 outline__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and is disposed within said columnar body in electrical communication with said base member and said light emitting diodes__.

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, __said body including a plurality of integral radially extending fins and having substantially straight side walls__, attaching at most one light emitting diode to each side of said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and a screw or wedge base connector closes a first end of said body with a second end of said body being open__.

19. (Cancelled)

20. (Cancelled)
